ns2:course.label: Fundamental Organic Chem I
ns2:course.description: Fundamental structural, synthetic, and mechanistic organic chemistry is presented. For students whose major is chemistry or for those in the specialized curricula in chemistry or chemical engineering. The first term of a two-term integrated sequence (to be followed by CHEM 436). This lecture course is intended to accompany CHEM 237. Students may not receive credit for both CHEM 236 and CHEM 232. Prerequisite: CHEM 204, CHEM 121 or CHEM 222 through CHEM 223.
